validated_product.marketing_description: The Smart Irrigation Management system is an advanced web-based application designed to modernize agricultural practices by automating water usage monitoring and management. Built with a Python (Streamlit) frontend and a MySQL backend, this system provides a centralized digital platform for tracking real-time environmental data, managing diverse field zones, and recording precise soil moisture levels. It eliminates manual paperwork, reduces human error, and promotes sustainable farming through data-driven decision-making.
bullet_points: Centralized digital dashboard for real-time monitoring of registered field zones and crop types.
Robust MySQL relational database for secure storage of soil parameters, crop requirements, and water distribution logs.
User-friendly Streamlit interface with manual moisture data logging via an intuitive slider (0-100%).
Supports optional IoT integration with ESP32/Arduino microcontrollers, capacitive soil moisture sensors, and DHT11 temperature/humidity sensors.
Enables historical data tracking and trend analysis to minimize water wastage and reduce pumping costs.
